description: A shell script for building Docker images, running integration tests, and orchestrating tests for Docker Compose and Helm within a containerized environment.

methods.name: build_docker
methods.description: Builds Docker images, optionally skipping Java build and mockserver rebuild based on environment variables.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs a specified integration test case by changing directory and executing the test script.

methods.name: run_all_tests
methods.description: Coordinates execution of multiple Docker and Helm tests, logs results, and exits with appropriate status.
